_meta.rule: A TEST_FIXTURE skill record is valid only if it names an authorisation here whose status is approved or spent. A draft authorisation admits nothing. Entries are never deleted: a spent one stays so its records remain explained.
_meta.enforcement: Detective, not preventive. A skill is executed by Claude Code following SKILL.md, so no code can stop a run. skill_run_gate.py fails on any fixture record that breaks these rules, and on any marked record in the real log.
_meta.scope: Non-A001 fixtures only. A001 skill records stay deferred under A001 D6 (T1-4), and the gate refuses any fixture record naming A001.

authorisations.permits_external_write: ONE disposable ClickUp task on the canonical Lead list: create, set the four governed tags, read them back, delete it, confirm its absence. Nothing else - no Notion, Offer, Content, event or second task, and no retry.
authorisations.note: Draft. The gate refuses any record written under it while it is draft, and it admits exactly one record when approved.
